title: Refreshed Molten Vents x Better Create Palettes
description: Improves the visual appearance of molten vent blocks
body:
This resource pack changes the appearance of Molten Vents blocks, improving their look and making them more polished. Intended to be used with [Better Create Palettes](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/recreated) by Kayladillo.

Special thanks to **LopyLuna** and authors of these mods:
- **Create**
- **Create Molten Vents**
- **Alex's Caves**

Made with Pixel Composer & Paint.NET
